about: Known answers for the illustration-check pilot (owner, 2026-10-23: "make the pilot a test with known answers"): 15 images with problems found by eye, 5 judged fine. Written before any model was run. Scored by scripts/score-known-answers.ts.
by: coding agent (Claude, a closed model), 2026-10-23, by eye. The 15 problems are copied from the consistency review (another coding agent, by eye, beside the sheets; content/snowmoon/consistency/review.json on branch illustration-consistency, PR #48); the 5 fine ones were picked and checked by eye here, beside each character's sheet picture and facts, for doubles, contradictions and stray text. DRAFT for the owner: the owner's own look decides.

scoring.double: caught when the answer lists a reference_copy_in_crowd problem (also reported: caught under another type)
scoring.problem: caught when the answer lists any problem and its verdict is not matches
scoring.fine: flagged when the verdict is not matches (problems listed on a matches verdict are reported too)
scoring.verdict: agreement: double -> wrong; problem -> partly or wrong; fine -> matches
